# Median

Gives the middle value of the numbers in an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Median(values)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | array | The array of numbers, in any order. A null element is skipped and not counted; any other element that is not a number is a runtime error. Null is read as an empty array, and a value that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. With the numbers in ascending order, the middle one, returned as it is in the array, when there is an odd count; the mean of the two middle ones when there is an even count. That mean is exact when both are exact and it can be held exactly, and otherwise is computed with floating-point values. Null when the array holds no numbers: when it is empty, null, or holds only null elements.

## Example

`Median([3, 1, 2])` returns `2`.

`Median([4, 1, 3, 2])` returns `2.5`.
